{
  "metadata": {
    "template_id": "LIC-FULL-v10.24",
    "template_name": "LinkedIn InMail Cold Outreach - Complete with Hardened Enforcement",
    "version": "10.24",
    "base_version": "10.23.1",
    "patches_applied": [
      "v10.23: Staging Buffer Integration",
      "v10.23.1: Scope Isolation Fix",
      "v10.24: Complete Enforcement Hardening (59 new rules, 2 new batches)"
    ],
    "created_date": "2025-10-15",
    "status": "PRODUCTION_READY",
    "changelog": {
      "v10.22": "Baseline - metadata-based validation",
      "v10.23": "Added staging buffer for ground truth validation (DO NOT USE - has scope bug)",
      "v10.23.1": "Fixed scope isolation bug - artist_output deleted before validation",
      "v10.24": "Complete enforcement hardening - 100% coverage of all enforcement points"
    },
    "critical_enhancements": [
      "Added BATCH_0_PRE_FLIGHT with 12 structural validation rules",
      "Added BATCH_5_POST_VALIDATION with 10 monitoring rules",
      "Added 37 additional enforcement rules for complete coverage",
      "All 89 enforcement points now have QA validation mapping",
      "Zero critical gaps remaining"
    ],
    "architecture": "Staging Buffer Pattern with Hard Scope Isolation and Complete Enforcement",
    "coverage": {
      "before_v10.24": "47% (42/89 enforcement points mapped)",
      "after_v10.24": "100% (89/89 enforcement points mapped)",
      "critical_gaps_closed": 18,
      "new_validation_rules": 59,
      "new_validation_batches": 2
    }
  },

  "1_role": {
    "name": "LinkedIn InMail Cold Outreach Message Generator",
    "version": "10.24",
    "authority": "Generate personalized LinkedIn cold outreach messages using RAG-enhanced factual scaffolding, creative prose, and staging buffer validation with hard scope isolation and complete enforcement",
    "core_capabilities": [
      "Route selection (INMAIL, CONNECTION_REQ, FOLLOW_UP)",
      "Recipient archetype classification",
      "RAG-driven achievement extraction",
      "Factual scaffold construction",
      "Artist-driven prose generation",
      "Staging buffer capture (ground truth)",
      "QA validation with scope isolation",
      "Gate-based output control",
      "Pre-flight structural validation (NEW)",
      "Post-validation monitoring (NEW)"
    ],
    "governance_toggles": {
      "STAGING_BUFFER_ENABLED": true,
      "SCOPE_ISOLATION_ENFORCED": true,
      "QA_ENGINE_VERSION": "V3",
      "MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED": true,
      "ARTIST_METADATA_BLOCKED": true,
      "PRE_FLIGHT_VALIDATION": true,
      "POST_VALIDATION_MONITORING": true
    },
    "critical_rules": [
      "SCOPE ISOLATION: artist_output MUST be deleted before validation",
      "SCOPE ISOLATION: Validation functions signature: def validate(staging_buffer: dict) ONLY",
      "SCOPE ISOLATION: Every validation batch MUST check: if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError()",
      "SCOPE ISOLATION: QA reports MUST read from staging_buffer[section]['word_count']",
      "SCOPE ISOLATION: Test LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 (MS Word verification) MUST pass before production",
      "ENFORCEMENT: All 89 enforcement points MUST have corresponding validation rules",
      "ENFORCEMENT: BATCH_0_PRE_FLIGHT MUST execute before all other batches",
      "ENFORCEMENT: BATCH_5_POST_VALIDATION MUST execute after gate decision"
    ]
  },

  "2_task": {
    "purpose": "Generate high-quality, personalized cold outreach messages that respect recipient archetypes, maintain factual accuracy, and comply with strict word count and content constraints",
    "deliverable": "Final message file with K-node structure (K.1 greeting, K.2 subject, K.3 body, K.5 CTA, K.6 signature) validated against staging buffer with complete enforcement",
    "workflow_phases": [
      "Phase 1: The Analyst - Route Selection & Classification",
      "Phase 2: The Architect - Factual Scaffold Construction",
      "Phase 3: The Artist - Creative Prose Generation",
      "Phase 4: The Assembler - Staging Buffer Capture",
      "Phase 5: The Validator - QA Validation with Scope Isolation",
      "Phase 6: The Gate - Output Decision"
    ],
    "validation_batches": [
      "BATCH_0: Pre-Flight Structural Validation (NEW - 12 rules)",
      "BATCH_1: Constraint Compliance Validation",
      "BATCH_2: Confidence & Accuracy Validation",
      "BATCH_3: Entity & Source Validation",
      "BATCH_4: Format & Quality Validation",
      "BATCH_5: Post-Validation Monitoring (NEW - 10 rules)"
    ],
    "success_criteria": [
      "All pre-flight structural checks pass",
      "Route correctly classified from valid enum",
      "Archetype accurately identified from valid enum",
      "RAG achievements incorporated with source binding",
      "Word counts within route/archetype constraints",
      "Confidence thresholds met (per-claim and aggregate)",
      "No placeholders in output",
      "Staging buffer validates actual output",
      "Scope isolation verified (artist_output inaccessible)",
      "All 6 validation batches pass",
      "Manual MS Word verification matches QA report",
      "Post-validation monitoring confirms success"
    ]
  },

  "3_context": {
    "version_pins": {
      "LIC_VERSION": "10.24",
      "STAGING_BUFFER_VERSION": "1.0",
      "QA_ENGINE_VERSION": "V3",
      "SCOPE_ISOLATION_VERSION": "1.0",
      "ENFORCEMENT_VERSION": "2.0"
    },

    "routes": {
      "INMAIL": {
        "description": "LinkedIn InMail to non-connections",
        "word_range": [180, 250],
        "char_limit": 1900,
        "subject_line_required": true,
        "subject_word_range": [5, 8],
        "subject_char_limit": 60,
        "use_cases": ["C-level executives", "Hiring managers", "Decision makers"],
        "tone": "Professional, respectful, value-focused"
      },
      "CONNECTION_REQ": {
        "description": "Connection request message",
        "word_range": [40, 60],
        "char_limit": 300,
        "subject_line_required": false,
        "use_cases": ["Recruiters", "HR professionals", "Potential referrals"],
        "tone": "Friendly, brief, clear intent"
      },
      "FOLLOW_UP": {
        "description": "Follow-up message to existing connections",
        "word_range": [100, 150],
        "char_limit": 800,
        "subject_line_required": false,
        "use_cases": ["After initial contact", "Post-application", "Nurture sequence"],
        "tone": "Persistent but respectful, value-add"
      }
    },

    "archetypes": {
      "EXECUTIVE": {
        "description": "C-level, VP-level decision makers",
        "preferred_route": "INMAIL",
        "word_count_target": [200, 230],
        "focus": "Strategic value, business outcomes, leadership experience",
        "avoid": "Tactical details, excessive metrics, junior-level achievements"
      },
      "RECRUITER": {
        "description": "Technical recruiters, sourcing specialists",
        "preferred_route": "CONNECTION_REQ",
        "word_count_target": [45, 55],
        "focus": "Clear job fit, relevant skills, availability",
        "avoid": "Lengthy narratives, unrelated experience"
      },
      "HIRING_MANAGER": {
        "description": "Department heads, team leads",
        "preferred_route": "INMAIL",
        "word_count_target": [180, 210],
        "focus": "Team impact, relevant projects, technical depth",
        "avoid": "Generic statements, irrelevant industries"
      },
      "C_LEVEL": {
        "description": "CEO, CTO, COO level contacts",
        "preferred_route": "INMAIL",
        "word_count_target": [210, 240],
        "focus": "Executive presence, transformation, strategic initiatives",
        "avoid": "Micro-level details, implementation specifics"
      }
    },

    "k_node_structure": {
      "K.1_greeting": {
        "description": "Personalized greeting with recipient name",
        "word_range": [3, 6],
        "examples": ["Hi Sarah,", "Hello John,", "Good morning Dr. Chen,"],
        "required": true
      },
      "K.2_subject_line": {
        "description": "Subject line for InMail only",
        "word_range": [5, 8],
        "char_limit": 60,
        "required_for_routes": ["INMAIL"],
        "best_practices": ["Value proposition", "Curiosity hook", "No clickbait"]
      },
      "K.3_body": {
        "description": "Main message body with achievements and value proposition",
        "word_range_by_route": {
          "INMAIL": [160, 220],
          "CONNECTION_REQ": [30, 50],
          "FOLLOW_UP": [85, 130]
        },
        "structure": ["Hook", "Credibility", "Value proposition", "Social proof"],
        "required": true
      },
      "K.5_cta": {
        "description": "Call to action",
        "word_range": [18, 30],
        "examples": [
          "Would you be open to a brief conversation next week?",
          "Could we schedule 15 minutes to discuss this role?",
          "I'd appreciate 10 minutes of your time if available."
        ],
        "required": true
      },
      "K.6_signature": {
        "description": "Professional signature block",
        "line_count": [3, 4],
        "includes": ["Name", "Current/recent title", "Contact info"],
        "required": true
      }
    },

    "global_constraints": {
      "component_constraints": {
        "K.1_greeting": {
          "word_min": 3,
          "word_max": 6,
          "must_include": ["recipient_first_name"]
        },
        "K.2_subject_line": {
          "word_min": 5,
          "word_max": 8,
          "char_limit": 60,
          "applies_to_routes": ["INMAIL"]
        },
        "K.3_body": {
          "word_min_by_route": {
            "INMAIL": 160,
            "CONNECTION_REQ": 30,
            "FOLLOW_UP": 85
          },
          "word_max_by_route": {
            "INMAIL": 220,
            "CONNECTION_REQ": 50,
            "FOLLOW_UP": 130
          },
          "must_include_achievements": true,
          "min_achievement_count": 2,
          "paragraph_count_range": [2, 5],
          "avg_words_per_paragraph": [30, 80]
        },
        "K.5_cta": {
          "word_min": 18,
          "word_max": 30,
          "must_include_date_proposal": false,
          "must_include_timeframe": true,
          "tone": "Respectful ask, not demanding"
        },
        "K.6_signature": {
          "line_min": 3,
          "line_max": 4,
          "char_estimate_per_line": 40,
          "must_include": ["sender_name", "sender_title", "contact_info"]
        }
      },

      "confidence_thresholds": {
        "per_claim_minimum": 0.80,
        "aggregate_minimum": 0.95,
        "context_coherence_minimum": 0.80,
        "team_whitelist_minimum": 0.85
      },

      "character_encoding_rules": {
        "unicode_replacements": {
          "\u2018": "'",
          "\u2019": "'",
          "\u201C": "\"",
          "\u201D": "\"",
          "\u2014": "--",
          "\u2013": "-",
          "\u2026": "..."
        },
        "allowed_characters": "ASCII printable only",
        "emoji_policy": "Not allowed in professional outreach"
      },

      "tokenization_standard": {
        "method": "whitespace + punctuation splitting",
        "exclude_from_count": [],
        "note": "Must match MS Word tokenization for manual verification",
        "implementation": "len(text.split())",
        "contractions": "Count as 1 word (we're = 1, not 2)",
        "hyphenated_words": "Count as 1 word (state-of-the-art = 1)",
        "numbers_and_dates": "Count as words (Q4 = 1 word, 10/15/2025 = 1 word)"
      }
    }
  },

  "4_reasoning": {
    "purpose": "Multi-phase pipeline with staging buffer and scope isolation",

    "phase_1_analyst": {
      "name": "The Analyst: Route Selection & Classification",
      "engine": "Classification Engine",
      "inputs": ["Recipient LinkedIn profile", "Job description", "Sender profile"],
      "outputs": ["Route selection", "Archetype classification", "Constraint parameters"],
      "logic": {
        "route_selection": [
          "IF recipient_connection_status == 'not_connected' AND recipient_title CONTAINS ['CEO', 'CTO', 'VP', 'Director'] THEN route = INMAIL",
          "ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['Recruiter', 'Talent', 'Sourcing'] THEN route = CONNECTION_REQ",
          "ELSE IF recipient_connection_status == 'connected' AND prior_message_count > 0 THEN route = FOLLOW_UP",
          "ELSE route = CONNECTION_REQ"
        ],
        "archetype_classification": [
          "IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['CEO', 'Chief', 'President'] THEN archetype = C_LEVEL",
          "ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['VP', 'Vice President', 'SVP'] THEN archetype = EXECUTIVE",
          "ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['Recruiter', 'Talent Acquisition'] THEN archetype = RECRUITER",
          "ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['Manager', 'Director', 'Head of'] THEN archetype = HIRING_MANAGER",
          "ELSE archetype = HIRING_MANAGER (default)"
        ]
      },
      "constraint_lookup": {
        "word_range": "get_global_constraint('routes', route, 'word_range')",
        "char_limit": "get_global_constraint('routes', route, 'char_limit')",
        "target_word_count": "get_target_word_count(route, archetype)"
      }
    },

    "phase_2_architect": {
      "name": "The Architect: Factual Scaffold Construction",
      "engine": "RAG + Entity Grounding Engine",
      "inputs": ["Sender resume/profile", "Job description", "Company research"],
      "outputs": ["Factual scaffold", "RAG achievements", "Entity grounding map"],
      "rag_pipeline": {
        "step_1": "Extract sender achievements from resume",
        "step_2": "Score achievements against job requirements",
        "step_3": "Select top 3-5 most relevant achievements",
        "step_4": "Extract metrics with ±20 word context windows",
        "step_5": "Build metric_source_map for validation"
      },
      "entity_grounding": {
        "companies": "Extract sender employment history → validated_companies whitelist",
        "teams": "Extract team descriptions → team_whitelist for validation",
        "metrics": "Map each metric to source document → metric_source_map",
        "job_title": "Extract target job title for position validation"
      },
      "factual_scaffold_structure": {
        "sender_name": "string",
        "recipient_name": "string",
        "recipient_title": "string",
        "company_name": "string",
        "job_title": "string",
        "achievements": "array of objects with {text, metric, context, confidence}",
        "validated_companies": "array of strings",
        "team_whitelist": "array of strings",
        "metric_source_map": "object mapping metrics to sources"
      }
    },

    "phase_3_artist": {
      "name": "The Artist: Creative Prose Generation",
      "engine": "LLM (GPT-4, Claude, etc.)",
      "inputs": ["Factual scaffold", "Route constraints", "Archetype parameters"],
      "outputs": ["Artist-generated content for all K-nodes", "Artist metadata (DO NOT TRUST)"],
      "generation_instructions": {
        "K.1_greeting": "Generate personalized greeting using recipient_name",
        "K.2_subject": "Generate compelling subject line (INMAIL only) within word/char limits",
        "K.3_body": "Weave factual scaffold achievements into natural prose, maintain authenticity",
        "K.5_cta": "Generate respectful call to action within constraints",
        "K.6_signature": "Format professional signature with sender details"
      },
      "artist_metadata_warning": {
        "CRITICAL": "Artist may generate metadata claims (e.g., word_count: 215) but these CANNOT BE TRUSTED",
        "BUG_HISTORY": "Job Workflow v1.6.2: Artist claimed 129 words but actual was 111 words",
        "SOLUTION": "Staging buffer will capture ACTUAL rendered text and compute ground truth measurements"
      },
      "artist_output_structure": {
        "K.1": {"text": "string", "word_count": "integer (DO NOT TRUST)"},
        "K.2": {"text": "string", "word_count": "integer (DO NOT TRUST)"},
        "K.3": {"text": "string", "word_count": "integer (DO NOT TRUST)", "achievements": "array"},
        "K.5": {"text": "string", "word_count": "integer (DO NOT TRUST)"},
        "K.6": {"text": "string", "line_count": "integer (DO NOT TRUST)"}
      }
    },

    "phase_4_assembler_staging": {
      "name": "The Assembler: Staging Buffer Capture",
      "engine": "Deterministic Assembly + Staging Buffer Extractor",
      "inputs": ["Artist-generated content"],
      "outputs": ["staging_buffer with ground truth measurements"],
      "critical_process": "This phase provides GROUND TRUTH for validation",

      "assembly_steps": {
        "step_1": "Render all K-nodes to temporary buffer",
        "step_2": "Extract each K-node section as raw text string (no metadata)",
        "step_3": "Compute actual word counts using standardized tokenizer",
        "step_4": "Compute actual character counts including spaces and punctuation",
        "step_5": "Extract structural elements (paragraphs, claims, metrics)",
        "step_6": "Store all extracted data in staging_buffer object",
        "step_7": "Pass staging_buffer to QA Engine V3 for validation",
        "step_8": "DO NOT allow Artist metadata to bypass staging buffer"
      },

      "scope_isolation_enforcement": {
        "CRITICAL_STEP_9": "Create backup: artist_output_backup = deepcopy(artist_output)",
        "CRITICAL_STEP_10": "DELETE from scope: del artist_output",
        "CRITICAL_STEP_11": "Verification: assert 'artist_output' not in locals()",
        "CRITICAL_STEP_12": "All validation passes staging_buffer ONLY",
        "CRITICAL_STEP_13": "After validation: Restore artist_output_backup for final rendering (if validation passes)",
        "RATIONALE": "Hard scope isolation prevents validation from accidentally reading artist_output instead of staging_buffer"
      },

      "staging_buffer_structure": {
        "K.1_greeting_actual": {
          "raw_text": "string - actual rendered greeting text",
          "word_count": "integer - len(raw_text.split())",
          "char_count": "integer - len(raw_text)",
          "contains_recipient_name": "boolean"
        },
        "K.2_subject_actual": {
          "raw_text": "string - actual rendered subject line",
          "word_count": "integer - computed from raw_text",
          "char_count": "integer - computed from raw_text",
          "applies_to_routes": ["INMAIL"]
        },
        "K.3_body_actual": {
          "raw_text": "string - actual rendered body text",
          "word_count": "integer - computed from raw_text",
          "char_count": "integer - computed from raw_text",
          "paragraphs": "array - split on double newline",
          "paragraph_count": "integer",
          "claims": "array - extracted atomic claims",
          "metrics": "array - extracted metrics with context windows",
          "companies": "array - extracted company names",
          "team_descriptions": "array - extracted team/role descriptions",
          "achievements": "array - extracted achievements",
          "achievement_count": "integer"
        },
        "K.5_cta_actual": {
          "raw_text": "string - actual rendered CTA text",
          "word_count": "integer - computed from raw_text",
          "char_count": "integer - computed from raw_text",
          "date_proposals": "array - extracted date strings",
          "contains_timeframe": "boolean",
          "tone_indicators": "array - extracted tone words"
        },
        "K.6_signature_actual": {
          "raw_text": "string - actual rendered signature block",
          "line_count": "integer - count newlines + 1",
          "estimated_chars": "integer - actual char count",
          "contains_name": "boolean",
          "contains_title": "boolean",
          "contains_contact": "boolean"
        },
        "full_message_actual": {
          "raw_text": "string - complete assembled message",
          "word_count": "integer - total word count",
          "char_count": "integer - total char count",
          "route": "string - resolved route name",
          "archetype": "string - classified recipient type",
          "k_node_sequence": "array - order of K-nodes in message"
        }
      },

      "tokenization_implementation": {
        "function": "def compute_word_count(text: str) -> int: return len(text.split())",
        "consistency_requirement": "MUST match MS Word tokenization for manual verification",
        "test": "LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 requires MS Word count to match staging_buffer count exactly"
      }
    },

    "phase_5_validator": {
      "name": "The Validator: QA Validation with Scope Isolation",
      "engine": "QA Engine V3",
      "inputs": ["staging_buffer ONLY (artist_output deleted)"],
      "outputs": ["ValidationResult or FatalValidationException"],
      "critical_rule": "QA Engine V3 has ZERO access to artist_output (scope isolated)",

      "scope_isolation_verification": {
        "pre_validation_check": "if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError('artist_output still accessible')",
        "function_signature": "def validate(staging_buffer: dict) -> ValidationResult",
        "mandatory_scope_check": "Every validation batch MUST check: if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError()"
      },

      "validation_batches": {
        "batch_0_pre_flight": {
          "priority": 0,
          "blocking": true,
          "estimated_tokens": 2000,
          "execution_order": "BEFORE_ALL_OTHER_BATCHES",
          "description": "Structural pre-flight validation before expensive content validation",

          "checks": [
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-000",
              "name": "Route enum validation",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['full_message_actual']['route']",
              "validation_logic": "assert route in ['INMAIL', 'CONNECTION_REQ', 'FOLLOW_UP']",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-000: Invalid route')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-001A",
              "name": "Archetype enum validation",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['full_message_actual']['archetype']",
              "validation_logic": "assert archetype in ['EXECUTIVE', 'RECRUITER', 'HIRING_MANAGER', 'C_LEVEL']",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-001A: Invalid archetype')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-003",
              "name": "Subject line presence for INMAIL",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['K.2_subject_actual']",
              "validation_logic": "if route == 'INMAIL': assert K.2_subject_actual is not None and len(raw_text) > 0",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-003: INMAIL requires subject line')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-004",
              "name": "Subject line exclusion for non-INMAIL",
              "severity": "WARNING",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['K.2_subject_actual']",
              "validation_logic": "if route != 'INMAIL': assert K.2_subject_actual is None or len(raw_text) == 0",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-004: Non-INMAIL routes should not have subject line')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-005",
              "name": "K.1 greeting presence",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['K.1_greeting_actual']",
              "validation_logic": "assert K.1_greeting_actual is not None and len(raw_text) > 0",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-005: K.1 greeting missing')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-006",
              "name": "K.3 body presence",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['K.3_body_actual']",
              "validation_logic": "assert K.3_body_actual is not None and len(raw_text) > 0",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-006: K.3 body missing')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-007",
              "name": "K.5 CTA presence",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['K.5_cta_actual']",
              "validation_logic": "assert K.5_cta_actual is not None and len(raw_text) > 0",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-007: K.5 CTA missing')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-008",
              "name": "K.6 signature presence",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['K.6_signature_actual']",
              "validation_logic": "assert K.6_signature_actual is not None and len(raw_text) > 0",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-008: K.6 signature missing')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-009",
              "name": "K-node sequence validation",
              "severity": "CRITICAL",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer['full_message_actual']['k_node_sequence']",
              "validation_logic": "Verify K-nodes appear in correct order: K.1, K.2 (if INMAIL), K.3, K.5, K.6",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
              "on_failure": "raise FatalValidationException('LIC-QA-009: K-nodes out of sequence')"
            },
            {
              "rule_id": "LIC-QA-013",
              "name": "K-node uniqueness",
              "severity": "HIGH",
              "data_source": "staging_buffer keys",
              "validation_logic": "Verify each K-node section appears exactly once",
              "scope_check": "assert 'artist_output' not in dir()",
